newsitem.title: CHINA: Accidents kill 27 on new Beijing-HK railway.
newsitem.headline: Accidents kill 27 on new Beijing-HK railway.

text.p: At least 27 people have been killed and nine badly injured by trains on the new Beijing-Hong Kong railway in the three months since it opened on September 1, the People's Daily reported on Thursday.
A total of 49 accidents occurred in the period in the eastern province of Jiangxi. The number of deaths and injuries apply only to Jiangxi and do not include accidents in other areas along the route.
The newspaper said most of the victims were people living along the railway who were hit as they crossed the tracks.
In addition, 12 head of cattle have been killed by trains along the Jiangxi section of the line, it said.
The line was opened with great fanfare and hailed by Beijing as a new source of prosperity for Hong Kong, which returns to China on July 1, 1997, and for the areas along the line.
